title: A request shows its whole journey
description: A client request used to stop at "Approved", even when the work behind it was long finished. It now shows where the work is and everything that happened on the way.
items: A progress line: submitted, team leader review, in progress, QA, client approval, completed
A timeline of every step, who took it, how long it waited, and any reason given
QA send-backs, the client's answer and their rating
Time logged, due date, list, turnaround, resolution and output link on the work
